## Describe the Feature
A clear and concise description of what you want to achieve.

## Security & Zero-Knowledge Architecture Review
How does this feature align with our security invariants?
- Will the server see any new metadata?
- Does it require client-side Web Crypto key derivation?
- How is metadata protection maintained?

## Proposed Implementation Details
Briefly describe your proposed design or components involved (e.g. state stores, cryptography worker updates, signaling message extensions).

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
